matches.rationale: GT1 concerns an inconsistency in the gap condition (4‖E‖ vs 5‖E‖, strict vs non-strict inequality) across the proof and Lemma 3.1. None of the findings mention this gap-condition discrepancy; finding 2 discusses a different alleged error (sign/order in the resolvent identity) within the same lemma's proof, which is a different specific claim, not the gap-condition inconsistency.

GT2 concerns ambiguity in Theorem 2.3 over whether the max is taken over the boundary or interior of the rectangle Γ1. None of the findings address this notational/scope ambiguity; they instead focus on log-term omissions and a resolvent identity error, which are unrelated defects.
